comparison.objective: Raise two unstable halves into a mutually supporting arch; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Synchronized bimanual placement and simultaneous release versus recessed fastener access, collar rotation and iterative tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Both halves stand together on marks with both grippers released versus repeatable bounded-energy stops and retained setting.
comparison.reason: Coordinated stabilization of an assembly is different from adjusting and testing a dissipative mechanism.
